verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents native 'dbt Projects on Snowflake', which brings the full dbt lifecycle (develop, deploy, orchestrate, observe) into the platform. It provides managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes and a dedicated migration guide from dbt Core. Community comments confirm dbt is widely run against Snowflake, though one notes limited vendor guidance on clustering for dbt incremental models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the native dbt Projects feature specifically, and explicit evidence of the standalone dbt adapter docs.
